heading: About Me
paragraphs: Most of my research centers on LLM reasoning, the security of AI agents, and intelligent edge systems. I'm fascinated by how a model arrives at an answer, what it treats as trustworthy, and what happens when it interacts with tools or external data. These are the questions that keep me returning to the code and the papers.

I focus on investigating these problems with analytical rigor—working through the assumptions behind a method, testing failure cases, and validating ideas through small-scale implementations. My research is ongoing, and I'm constantly building better ways to evaluate results and communicate technical limitations clearly.

Alongside research, I actively build full-stack web products and collaborate on software projects. Building production-ready interfaces and workflows gives me practical engineering problems to ground my theoretical work. I've also spent significant time tutoring, where explaining complex concepts to others helps sharpen my own understanding.
quote: Exploring how models reason, where systems fail, and how to build software that lasts.
